Stage.LogText: {=da_log_3_1}A messenger from {EfsaneviDemirci_Link} rides into your encampment, breathless and distraught. Catastrophe has struck the brotherhood of the anvil. Ride swiftly to the master's side.

{=da_log_3_2}The smith's brother and fellow master craftsman, {Kalan_Link}, rots in the foul dungeon of {DusmanKale_Link}. The captors have condemned him to death and will execute him in 5 days! Infiltrate the castle, raise a siege, or ransom him before the executioner strikes.

Action.Title: {=da_inquiry_idam_title}Gallows of Fate
Action.Text: {=da_inquiry_idam_text}Dark tidings reach your camp from the blood-soaked dungeons of {DusmanKale_Name}... The executioner's cold steel has severed {Kalan_Name}'s life. With the master craftsman dead, the secrets of the ritual forge are lost forever.

Stage.LogText: {=da_log_3_fail}You failed to rescue {Kalan_Link} from the dungeons of {DusmanKale_Link} before the executioner struck. The sacred covenant fire is extinguished forever.
{=da_log_3_3}Against all odds, {Kalan_Link} breathes the air of freedom! The twin masters of the anvil are reunited at last, ready to kindle the ritual fires for the ancestral masterpiece.

DialogNode.Text: {=da_haber_p_giris}Your messenger rode his horse near to death, master. What grief has fallen upon you?

{=da_haber_dlg_1}My brother, {Kalan_Link}... While traveling the mountain passes with rare quenching fluxes, he was ambushed and cast into the dungeon of {DusmanKale_Link}. Worse still, their bloodthirsty lord condemned him as a spy and declared he will hang from the ramparts in five days! His hands alone possess the secret temper to bind the blade's edge. Without him, our covenant labor turns to dust. I beg of you, rescue him before the executioner strikes!
{=da_u3_p_sorgu_zanaat}Why is Master Kalan's craft so indispensable? What is the secret of these quenching salts, master?
{=da_u3_p_sorgu_askeri}How formidable are the defenses of {DusmanKale_Link}? Does wrenching him from the dungeon in five days require stealth, siege, or open assault?
{=da_u3_p_sorgu_fidye}Did the captors not demand a ransom, master? Can gold not stay the executioner's hand before five days run out?
{=da_usta_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=da_u3_npc_lore_zanaat}We are twin masters of the anvil; I shape the steel and rule the flames, while Kalan listens to the metal's song at the moment of quenching. With celestial fluxes he tempers the blade so it remains keen as a razor yet supple as a willow branch. If the headsman severs his neck in five days, this sword is stillborn!

{=da_u3_npc_lore_askeri}{DusmanKale_Link} is a grim stronghold perched atop sheer crags. The dungeon guards are heavily armed and the gallows are already prepared in the courtyard. You must infiltrate the castle, break him out, or ransom him before the five-day deadline expires!

{=da_u3_npc_lore_fidye}They scorn all talk of ransom! The castellan seeks to hang him publicly to terrorize the countryside. In five days {Kalan_Link} will mount the scaffold unless you intervene. He must be freed from that pit by any means necessary!
{=da_u3_p_sorgu_parola}When I reach the dungeons of {DusmanKale_Link}, how shall Master Kalan know I come to save him? What must I say?
{=da_u3_p_sorgu_kusatma}Five days leave no time to hesitate. If we must raise a siege or storm the gates, will {Kalan_Link} endure until our arrival?
{=da_usta_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=da_u3_npc_lore_parola}Whisper our ancient guild vow into his ear: 'The sacred fire turns to ash never, and true steel bends never.' When he hears those words, he will know the covenant has answered his plight.
{=da_u3_npc_lore_kusatma}He is weakened by damp stone and starvation, yet his will is hammered iron. But the five-day deadline is absolute; once the executioner's bell tolls, all is lost!
{=da_u3_p_yemin_sovalye}No brother of our anvil shall die upon an enemy gallows. I swear upon my clan's honor to rescue {Kalan_Link} from {DusmanKale_Link} before five days elapse.
{=da_u3_p_yemin_savasci}The executioner at {DusmanKale_Link} will find only his own grave! I ride at once, and within five days {Kalan_Link} shall walk free!
{=da_usta_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=da_u3_npc_ugurla}May the ancestral spirits grant swiftness to your horses, warrior! The sand is slipping through the hourglass. In five days the headsman will strike. Ride to {DusmanKale_Link} and bring my brother home alive!
{=da_u3_bekle_p}Do you have any further word regarding {Kalan_Link}, master?
{=da_u3_bekle_npc}Every moment counts! The five-day deadline at {DusmanKale_Link} draws near with every setting sun. Break {Kalan_Link} out before the executioner claims him!
